title: klein-sdlc project manifest
description: Every project-specific name the klein-sdlc skills use, once. Lives at .claude/sdlc.json in the host repo; skills inject it at load time and name a value by its path.

project.description: The open build project the board skills read.

scopeLabels.description: PR label -> path prefixes that earn it.

gates.description: Verification commands, run in order, each to completion, before any commit.

rules.description: Fixed: the skills and lanes read the rules corpus at .claude/docs/rules/. The key names its index so the manifest lists every doc in one place.

practices.description: Fixed: the skills and lanes read the practices corpus at .claude/docs/practices/.

reviewCatalogues.description: Directory holding one catalogue per review lane; review.lanes[].catalogue is a file name inside it.

qa.description: The QA catalogue manual-qa-engineer reads first: apps, ports, sign-in per role, blocked-not-defect failures, seeded data. Shape: templates/qa-catalogue.md.

uxHouseRules.description: Part 2 of the UX standard: the product's audiences and the rules that take sides for each. Shape: templates/ux-house-rules.md.

specTemplate.description: The host's own spec template, when the plugin's does not fit. Omitted, write-spec uses templates/spec-template.md from the plugin. Shape: that file.

lanes.description: The review lanes, in the order full-review spawns and reports them. Put the lanes whose findings are things that are broken (reachability, wrongness) ahead of the conformance ones.

agent.description: The subagent to spawn, exactly as the Agent tool names it: a bare name for an agent in the host's .claude/agents/, or plugin-qualified such as klein-sdlc:basic-reviewer.

catalogue.description: The lane's catalogue, a file name under docs.reviewCatalogues.

trigger.description: "always": runs on any diff. "catalogue": runs when a changed path matches the trigger list the catalogue carries under § Trigger paths. A list: runs when a changed path starts with one of these prefixes.

optionalCatalogue.description: true: spawn the lane even when its catalogue is missing; its agent file says how it degrades. Default false: a lane with no catalogue is skipped and named in the report's opening line.

roles.description: The agents deliver-ticket spawns for each role, exactly as the Agent tool names them. A role left out falls back to the plugin's generic agent (klein-sdlc:<agent>); name a host agent in .claude/agents/ to override it.

planReviewer.description: Reviews the plan in fresh context. Default klein-sdlc:plan-reviewer.

developer.description: Builds one unit of the plan, or fixes findings in files it owns. Default klein-sdlc:developer.

qa.description: Drives the running app against the acceptance criteria. Default klein-sdlc:manual-qa-engineer.

babysitter.description: Takes one open PR to merged. Default klein-sdlc:babysitter.
